text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How's this? What if we pass out boba
tea made
with Nambu kettles?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's a... novel... approach,
but would it
really
help promote Morioka?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Promoting Morioka... They must be
talking about the Traveling Morioka
Festival from the other
day. Yukino Bijin
said she'd help promote it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Perfect timing. I was
thinking of ways
to promote the fest'val,
and I'd love to pick your
brain.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout organiz'n one of those "flash
mobs"?
Those are really hip and modern.
We'd be the talk
of town!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's true... There's gotta be
somethin'
more hip...
choice_data_list: Hmm... That might not feel very Mo...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Say, what if you just drop the idea
of
making the promotion flashy?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Why not just tell people what you love
about
Morioka straight-up instead of
trying to stand
out?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you referr'n to... our talk about
sansa
odori?
choice_data_list: You told me about that back at the...
You told me about that back at the...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Some kind of talk steeped in
memories, I
presume? That sounds like a
good place to start.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: That was someth'n... Speak'n of wax'n nostalgic... Aha!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I was in elementary school, I
played the taiko drums for the sansa
odori at a local fest'val! It was strapped
to my chest and I'd hit it while I
walked.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Its way hard'r than y'might think! Botch
up the
drumm'n, and the dance goes out
of whack!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I think I can relate. It's hard not to
be nervous
when your actions impact
everyone around you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Exactamundo. So, when I was down in
the dumps one time after mess'n up, my
taiko teach'r came
up to me, and...
hehehe. Guess what she said?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: She said it's okay to mess up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She reminded me that sansa is the same
musical
phrase repeat'n over and over as
we walk a long
way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And that means n'matter how many
times y'mess up, you can always fix it
next time. As long as you
had fun and
are smil'n when you're finished...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Then all's well that ends well.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. I dig it. Like, be yourself and
don't try to
put on a front. That kind of
thing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's right. Just be myself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's gotta be it! The thing I love about
Morioka
is... just being able t'be your
plain ol' self and
smile!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now there's a good look for you.
Tell the
customers exactly that.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I-I see! But how can I get that across?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Experience it for themselves, huh... Oh,
in that
case!
choice_data_list: Let's have them experience it firs...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I pass by the dance
studio to see Yukino Bijin practicing the
taiko drums while
Gold City dances
along.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! So that was the sound of a taiko drum! ♪ What kind of dance are you doing? I wanna try too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly! If it isn't Curren! Here, lemme
show you the
steps!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
One, two, one, two! That's it! You're
doin' great!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-all right!
If I play the taiko drums just like this
on the day of th'event, I bet I'll
bring in cust'mers
by the dozen!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A video?! Right! That way we can
promote
Morioka to people all ov'r
th'world!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sounds pretty good. Leave the filming to
me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Welcome to the
Trav'lin
Morioka Fest'val! Now, everyone
sansa odori!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold City films Yukino Bijin
dancing and
chatting away as natural as
can be. A few days
later...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yes, fam! Sansaaaa! Sakkora choiwaaa?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yasseeeee! ☆ That's what's up!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The sansa odori is such a cute dance! I've
gotta
upload a video of myself
dancing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Yukino. I saw your Umatok video! It
got a huge number of views, eh? Thanks
to you, the
fest'val looks like it's gonna
be a big hit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank goodn'ss! I'm just glad t'help!
Good luck
with the main event! Fing'rs
cross'd!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's dance video is a viral
sensation and, because of that, the
Traveling Morioka
Festival ends up a
huge success.
